description: Returns the total outstanding (unpaid) balance for the authenticated tenant, pulled live from Paddle. Lists each unpaid transaction with amount, currency, and due date. Use when the user asks 'do I have any unpaid invoices?', 'what is my outstanding balance?', 'how much do I owe?'. OwnerAdmin or Admin only.
name: get_outstanding_balance

outstanding_invoices.description: Array of outstanding invoice objects (transaction_id, status, amount, currency, billed_at)

title: Outstanding Balance
